messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-180246 triggered — metric: inference.p99 > 1.2s (5m window) for route /v1/generate (region=eu-west). Alert at 14:10 UTC. https://pagerduty.example/INC-180246
omar: acked. I'm oncall. seeing p99 ~1.4s, p95 ~220ms. No spike in errors yet, but some client timeouts reported.
pagerduty-bot: INC-180246 acknowledged by omar.
maya: checking KV cache heatmap and eviction logs — eviction spikes starting 14:06. eviction rate 0.18/s -> 0.5/s across pool-dedicated-eu.
jake: any customer-facing impact confirmed? which tenants?
omar: sampling logs — a few 504s from tenant: acme-inc between 14:08-14:12, most requests slow but succeed.
lena: I'm on rotation next. If you need takeover ping me; otherwise I'll join in 5.
omar: quick triage plan: 1) confirm autoscaler status 2) inspect worker OOMs 3) apply short-term routing fallback to compact model variant 4) prewarm KV cache replicas.
maya: query run: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))` -> 1.42s at 14:10.
omar: gpustat shows pool-dedicated-eu memory pressure ~89% on three nodes, one restart recorded at 14:07 (OOMKilled). kube events show frequent cache evictions.
jake: can we flip traffic to variant redwood-compact-1 for /v1/generate temporarily? that should cut tail.
omar: initiating fallback routing change now — policy ch_78: fallback -> redwood-compact-1 for route /v1/generate (scope: eu-west).
incident-bot: Policy change ch_78 executed: fallback updated.
maya: monitoring — p99 down to ~0.95s within 90s of change. p95 unchanged. Eviction rate dropping.
pagerduty-bot: INC-180246 reassigned to lena (oncoming).
lena: taking lead. I'll roll caches and adjust autoscaler thresholds. Jake, please draft a short customer note for CS.
jake: draft: "We observed elevated generation latency in eu-west between 14:05–14:22 UTC affecting a subset of users. Mitigation: traffic routed to an alternate model variant and caches warmed; service is trending back to normal. No data loss. We're investigating root cause and will follow up." pinging @cs for approval.
omar: patching worker env to lower KV_EVICT_THRESHOLD to 0.8 to reduce premature evictions: `kubectl -n inference patch deploy/worker -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"worker","env":[{"name":"KV_EVICT_THRESHOLD","value":"0.8"}]}]}}}'`
maya: triggering cache prewarm on 3 replicas: `POST https://console.redwood/api/v1/prewarm?pool=dedicated-eu&replicas=3` -> 202 Accepted.
lena: monitoring metrics: p99 stabilized ~0.88s for 5m window. I'll keep PD open until 10m of steady state. Omar, leave your notes in the incident log.
omar: added ops note: "OOM on worker due to KV memory growth -> eviction cascade -> tail latency. Mitigated by fallback routing + prewarm + eviction threshold tweak." :white_check_mark:
jake: CS approved customer note, sending now.
incident-bot: PD INC-180246 status: condition met (p99 < 1s for 10m). Incident resolved by lena at 14:32 UTC. Resolution: temporary routing fallback and cache adjustments. Follow-up: RCA to investigate autoscaler windows and KV eviction tuning.
lena: will own RCA. Closing handoff. If anyone sees regression re-open thread. :handshake:
